content: Musakna Laksak
Pharisee te Sadducee te pawlkhat taw Jesus kungah hongpai uh a, maw a zon nop uh man in tungsang musakna laksak hi.
Jesus in amate tung ah,

content.text: Nitak sang in van hong san le, khuapha tu hi.
Taciang zingsang ciang in, van hong san in khua hong niim le khuasia tu hi, ci nu hi. Maw no a ki hitheamsak te, van en in khuahun omdan tu telthei napi, hun le ni i musakna te telthei ngawl nu ziam?
Mi ngilo le tatsia tate in musakna zong napi; kamsang Jonah musakna simngawl a dang ki pia ngawl tu hi,

content: ci in zo kik hi. Tuazawkciang amate nusia in paisan hi.
Pharisee te Tol
Nungzuite ngalkhat ah hong thet uh ciang, anluum ken tu mangil uh hi.
Taciang in Jesus in,

content.text: Pharisee te le Sadducee te i tol pan in kidawm tavun,

content: ci hi.
Amate in anluum i ken ngawl hang hi, ci in amate kikum uh hi.
Tua thu Jesus in a heak ciang in,

content.text: Maw no upna no te, anluum na ken ngawl uh hang hi, ci in banghang in kikum nu ziam?
Anlum nga sia mihing tul nga in a neak zawkciang a val bawm bangza tawm nu ziam, ci he ngawl nu ziam?
Anlum sali mihing tul li in a neakzawkciang, a val bawm bangza tawm kik, ci sia phawk nawn ngawl nu ziam?
Pharisee le Saducee te tol kidawm vun kong ci ciang, anluum thu ka son nop na hi ngawl hi, ci banghang in tel thei ngawl nu ziam?

content: ci hi.
Tasiaciang a nungzui te in, anluum sung a tol kidawm tu a cinopna hi ngawl a, Pharisee le Saducee te hilna hi zaw, ci sia tel kik hi.
Peter in Jesus Pualak
Jesus in Ceasaria Philippi khua kiim a thet uh ciang, a nungzui te kungah,

content.text: Ngual in mihing Tapa sia kua hong ci uh ziam?

content: ci in dong hi.
Amate in, pawlkhat te in tuiphumpa John: pawlkhat te in Elijah; pawlkhat te in Jeremiah, a hibale kamsang khat papo, hong ci hi, ci uh hi.
Jesus in,

content.text: No ma na e, keima sia kua hi nong ci uh ziam?

content: ci in dong hi.
Simon Peter in zo a, Nangma sia a nungta Pathian Tapa, Christ na hihi, ci hi.
Tasiaciang Jesus in,

content.text: Jonah tapa Simon awng, thuphatoai na hihi: banghangziam cile, hi thu sia mihing cile sa le thisan in hong hesak thei ngawl hi, vantung a om Ka Pa in hong hesak hi.
Keima in kong son hi, nang sia Peter ni hi, hi suangpi tungah ka pawlpi ka phut tu hi; taciang hell ngam kongpi te in a zo zo batu hi.
Vantung kumpingam tawtang te kong pia tu hi: leitung ah na hen theampo vantung ah zong ki hen tu hi: leitung ah na tha theampo vantung ah zong ki tha tu hi,

content: ci hi.
Ama sia Christ kici Jesus a hina sia kuama a son ngawl natu in nungzui te vaitha hi.
Jesus in a Thi natu Thuson

Tua hun panin, Jesus in a nungzui te tung ah, Jerusalem a pai natu thu, ulian te, thiampi lian te le thukhamhil te hang in a thuak tu tampi te le ki that tu a, ni thum ni ciang a thawkik natu thu te son kipan hi.
Tasiaciang Peter in Jesus sia samtuam in tei hi, Topa awng, hi thu sia nangma taw ki khuala tahen a: na tungah hong theng heak tahen, ci hi.
Ahihang Jesus in le-et in, Peter kungah,

content.text: Satan, nang ka nung ah om in, kei hong khak in hongliksak na hihi: banghangziam cile Pathian thu sang in, mihing te thu kinzaw ni hi,

content: ci hi.
Tuazawkciang Jesus in a nungzui te kungah,

content.text: A kuamapo ka nung hong zui nuam peuma, ama le ama ki nial hen a, ama thinglamte pua in, hong zui tahen.
Banghangziam cile, kuamapo in, ama nuntakna a hun nuam sia sum tu a: keima atu in a nuntakna a sum peuma nuntakna mu tu hi.
Mihing khat in leitung theampo a nga zong in, a tha nuntakna a sum le bang phattuamna om ziam? mihing in a tha nuntakna bang taw theak thei tu ziam?
Mihing Tapa sia a Pa vangletna le Ama vantungmi te taw hongpai tu a; khatsim i a sep bang tek in thaman pia tu hi.
A tatak kong ci ciang, hi lai ah a om pawlkhat te, mihing Tapa Ama kumpingam sungah hongpaikik na mu uh dong thina a tep ngawl tu te omhi,

content: ci hi.
